CORE ARCHITECTURAL MECHANISM

How Bartholomew Works: 3-Step Mechanical Verification

Unlike conversational LLMs that guess solutions, Bartholomew guarantees deterministic correctness through closed-loop mechanical verification.

Step 1: Isolate & Reproduce

Clones the failing commit into an isolated container and synthesizes a standalone reproduction test proving the defect.

Step 2: Minimal AST Patch

Applies a surgical AST compiler patch strictly addressing the root-cause failure with zero collateral changes.

Step 3: Verification (100%)

Executes full test suites locally to prove 100% green passes with zero regressions before opening the GitHub PR.
